evidence_snippets: Annotation Description cnrm.cloud.google.com/mutable-but-unreadable-fields This annotation is added and managed by Config Connector for resources with mutable but unreadable fields (for example, "password" field in some resource spec). cnrm.cloud.google.com/observed-secret-versions This annotation is added and managed by Config Connector for resources with sensitive fields. cnrm.cloud.google.com/supports-ssa This annotation is added and managed by Config Connector for resources with server-side apply enabled . cnrm.cloud.google.com/blueprint This annotation is added for resources used in KRM blueprints .
